subject: Service degradation — customer update & next steps
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@crestfall.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:03:12 -0700
Subject: Increased error rate & token latency — are you seeing this?

Hi Tessa,

We started seeing a spike in error rates and 95th percentile token latency on our inference calls to the redwood-hosted model at ~08:55 PDT. The failures are intermittent but have impacted our customer-facing recommender feed.

Quick details:
- Region: us-west1
- Model: redwood-v1-small (default pinned)
- Symptoms: timeouts (HTTP 504) and 10–20% elevated latency for successful responses
- Example request ids: req_9a2f, req_9a3b

Can you confirm if there's anything on your side? We're currently routing around but this is high impact for our morning batch.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Lang
Director, Platform Engineering
Crestfall Analytics

(attachment: app-logs-tail-08-55.txt — text/plain)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@crestfall.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:20:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Increased error rate & token latency — are you seeing this?

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads up and the log snippet. We've opened an incident bridge and our SREs are actively investigating.

Immediate actions we've taken:
- Opened incident bridge (INF-6421) and prioritized Crestfall's traffic
- Enabled transparent routing to alternate GPU pool to reduce queuing
- Begun collecting detailed traces and KV-cache hit metrics for the window you reported

What to expect in the next 30–90 minutes:
- A short customer-facing update from me with what we know and mitigations in flight
- If we identify a model-side kernel regression we will transparently failover requests to a compatible variant while we continue diagnostics

I'm attaching the live incident log for your ops team to cross-reference. We'll keep this thread as the customer-facing summary channel — internal technical discussion is on the bridge (invitation sent to your ops alias earlier).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
Email: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0124

(attachment: crestfall_incident_log_20270420.txt — text/plain)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@crestfall.ai>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Increased error rate & token latency — customer update

Sophie / Tessa / Evelyn — quick executive-level update from the bridge and immediate next steps.

What we have so far:
- Root cause (investigating): a recently deployed kernel selection heuristic on the redwood-v1-small runtime led to suboptimal kernel choice for long-context requests in us-west1, causing higher CPU fallback and queuing under modest burst.
- Impact: intermittent 5–25% error rate on affected request shapes; observed 95th percentile token latency increase ~1.2–1.6x for the window you reported.

Mitigations in flight (we've already applied the first two):
1) Hotfix: revert the recent kernel routing tweak for redwood-v1-small in us-west1 (completed)
2) Traffic shift: steer Crestfall traffic to an alternate GPU pool with compatible drivers and warmed kernels (in progress)
3) Fallback: if instability persists, we will failover your calls to the previous stable model variant (redwood-v1-small-legacy) with identical API semantics but an expected latency uplift of ~5% (requires your sign-off)

Planned timeline:
- 11:20 PDT: complete traffic shift (target)
- 11:45 PDT: validate end-to-end success for a 15-minute window
- 12:30 PDT: if instability still present, propose failover to legacy variant (customer sign-off required)

Customer asks / commercial notes:
- We're tracking service impact and will include an incident credit proposal in the postmortem.
- We'll share a postmortem draft within 48 hours and invite Crestfall to comment before the public version is published.

Attachments: mitigation-checklist.pdf (bridge runbook extract) and postmortem-draft-crestfall.md (initial skeleton).

I will post another customer-facing update after we complete the traffic shift.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Platform Engineering — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
